name: E-Tech
title: E-Tech: Vanilla Recipes for AAI Industry + QoL Toggles
author: Eli Tellez
description: Restores vanilla recipes while keeping everything AAI Industry adds (Krastorio 2 aware - restores to K2's values when K2 is installed, and never stomps recipes other mods own). Plus optional startup toggles. The vanilla/AAI recipe tweaks default to vanilla behavior except where noted; nearly every added feature now defaults ON, on the grounds that a toggle you never found is a feature you never got - each is one switch away from off, ports of standalone mods auto-disable when you already have the original, and anything needing Space Age, Factorissimo or Jetpack does nothing without them. Off by default: total productivity, restoring K2's hidden nuclear fuel, the experimental teleport-to-player shortcut, and verbose logging. Features: pick up/re-place the crashed ship, all modules in beacons, quality in asteroid crushing/reprocessing, nuclear fuel & artillery shell stack sizes, agricultural science pack spoilage, restore the nuclear fuel crafting Krastorio 2 removes, uranium bacteria on Gleba (revival of the abandoned Simple Gleba Uranium mod), void chest & pipe (Easy Void), an in-game map settings editor on a toolbar shortcut (Edit Map Settings), plume-free thrusters (FPS Friendly Thrusters), pass-through fusion generators, per-recipe biochamber colors (Colorful Biochamber), copy modules with machine settings (Copy Paste Modules), a Krastorio 2 + Cerys nitric acid compat fix, quality-scaled module slots on every machine that has them (replaces QualityEffectsFixed), a factory outlet/inlet/sensor set that bridges items between Factorissimo factory interiors and the outside logistic network, a whole-floor logistics radius plus a real charging-pad count for the Factorissimo interior roboport (replaces factorissimo-roboport-buff, on by default), a fourth Factorissimo factory tier with a 120x120 interior behind an unchanged 16x16 exterior, and an experimental teleport-to-player toolbar shortcut for multiplayer.
